# 2026.11.20261109200750
## What's Changed
* fix(amazon-sns-sqs-mcp-server): remove pytest from runtime dependencies by @kluacisco888 in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4557
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): aws-pricing tells filter misses from bad service codes by @finklen-amazon in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4895
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): document COA account scope and criteria, fold restartNeeded criteria by @finklen-amazon in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4904
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): send Savings Plan IDs for exclusions and add a wait to sp-purchase-analyzer by @finklen-amazon in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4909
* feat(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): invoicing receiver_role, selector echo, and a description that matches the API by @yasmeenh11 in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4925
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): accept user:-prefixed keys and any-case enums in list-cost-allocation-tags by @Dinkie in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4930
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): scope rec-details Cost Explorer calls to the recommendation's account by @Dinkie in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4931
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): document the cost-explorer Tags filter format and hint on tag keys that cannot match by @finklen-amazon in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4941
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): drop legacy RESOURCE_TYPE group_by and test COH enum lists against the API by @somsubhro in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4945
* docs(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): warn that summing Cost Opti… by @somsubhro in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4946
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): retry guidance for a cancelled storage-lens query by @finklen-amazon in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4971
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): aws-pricing reaches every filter type by @finklen-amazon in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4922
* feat(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): add free-tier plan state and activities by @finklen-amazon in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4912
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): point a filtered forecast's no-data error at the filter by @finklen-amazon in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4940
* feat(aws-documentation-mcp-server): negotiate Markdown for read_sections by @kstich in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4977
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): return null for an estimate's IssuedDate and document filter limits by @finklen-amazon in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4987
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): document HOURLY in sp-performance by @wangyuhere in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4976
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): flag COH summaries that reach the 1,000-group limit by @mattkelsey in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4973
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): send filter for getTagsOrValues and getCostCategories by @finklen-amazon in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4970
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server)!: request COH savings percentage, coerce boolean filters, fold summaries group_by by @finklen-amazon in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4906
* chore(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): require Python 3.11 and update dnspython to 2.9 by @anniewn in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4995
* fix(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): surface EBS attachment_state… by @Anshul00S in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4966
* docs(amazon-qbusiness-anonymous-mcp-server): add migration guide and deprecation banner by @laithalsaadoon in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4981
* feat(aws-healthomics-mcp-server): support outputUriPrefixMode on StartAHORun and GetAHORun by @ParulGuptaCSE in https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/pull/4996
* feat(billing-cost-management-mcp-server): add dimension_key and document ProductAttributes filters in cost-explorer by @finklen-amazon in https
